resources.string: Shown in the app and on the web. Any language, up to 40 characters.
On that computer, open a terminal, paste this line and press Enter. It installs Persona\'s background service and connects.
This hub doesn\'t know where its install script is. Install Persona Link on that computer first, then paste this line in a terminal and press Enter.
Once it says it\'s paired, this screen moves on by itself.
On that computer, put Persona\'s two programs (the two .exe files in the line below) in one folder. There\'s no installer yet, so you build them yourself; the tray app is still in the works.
Open PowerShell in that folder, paste this line and press Enter.
It installs as a background task that starts when you sign in. No window, no admin rights.
Install Persona Link on that Mac. There\'s no installer yet, so you build it from source.
Send the pairing link to that Mac, click the Persona Link icon in the menu bar › Pair…, and paste it.
The computer hasn\'t connected. Make a new link and try again.
A computer wants to join: %1$s. Is it yours?
Only once you confirm does Persona work on it and give it your model keys. If you don\'t know it, reject it and it\'s removed.
It\'s in the machine list now, and you can pick it for new agents.
The pairing link it used no longer works. Add the computer again to try once more.
Nothing is waiting to be confirmed
Computers you add show up here once they connect.
Once it connects, you\'ll be asked here whether it\'s yours. If that computer doesn\'t have the pairing link yet, make a new one.
Once it connects, you\'ll be asked here whether it\'s yours.
This hub can\'t add computers from the phone yet
Add it on the web under Machines › Add a computer, or in the hub\'s admin page. After the hub is updated you can add it here.
It\'s connected and waits for you to confirm it\'s yours. Persona does nothing on it until then.
Once it connects, confirm whether it\'s yours.
Persona\'s background service isn\'t running on this computer. Open Persona Link and let it reinstall.
This computer is offline: Persona Link isn\'t running, or the computer is asleep.
This computer has never connected. Pair it once with its pairing link.
Persona on this computer is too old to update from here. Reinstall it on that computer.
The hub hasn\'t turned on secure connections, so computers can\'t connect. Turn them on in the hub\'s admin page › Network, then try again.
This hub is a member of a group. Add computers on the primary hub.
3 computers are already waiting for you to confirm them. Confirm or remove them first.
This device can\'t add computers. Try from an app or browser that\'s signed in.
Give it a name of up to 40 characters.
%1$s is offline, so a computer can\'t be added to it right now.
